text:
Brayden McNabb played his 900th NHL game on Oct. 30, and The Hockey News called him Vegas' "Enduring Knight in Shining Armor." On Sunday he went back to Buffalo, where his career started with 37 games for the Sabres, as one of three former Sabres in the Vegas lineup alongside Jack Eichel and Victor Olofsson. He came into it one point from 200 career points.

His 8 assists in 18 games already beat his 12 points from all of last season. The points rate won't hold (1.36 per 60 minutes against an expected 0.6 to 1.1), but the defense might. Vegas takes 62% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with McNabb at five on five, 12 points better than without him.

Evolving-Hockey had him in the 91st percentile last season at taking chances away, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says he stops 16% of the entries aimed at him (typical is 11%). He does it without speed: his top speed sits in the 7th percentile, which makes the positioning more impressive. He's 35, a 2023 Cup winner, and his minutes are up almost two a game lately. We project about 26 points.
headline: McNabb goes home to Buffalo
